objective: raw mission-weighted burned fuel kg, reserves excluded
cruise_control: design CL and initial altitude active; offdesign altitude prescribed, CL recomputed
rcls_rclt: clean climb/cruise/descent values across all missions via Wing.Aero.Climb fields; takeoff and landing unchanged
mission_limits: takeoff weight <= native sized MTOW; loaded fuel <= geometric capacity; all6 missions
excluded_from_objective_constraints: APD area and tail area fit bands
turbine metal temperature residual (not requested; report after freeze)
bounds_basis: Exploratory sensitivity bounds, not measured aircraft evidence. Reserve is existing scalar approximation; drag factors >=1; positive off-takes retained; efficiency below1. All frozen during eventual inner fuel solve.
special_tolerance: BFL and climb normalized1e-5 retained from source study; final acceptance additional1e-6; fuel normalized1e-7
taper_definition: Both ratios are relative to wing root chord: break/root and tip/root, as used by TASOPT wing_weights.jl. Ordered bounds enforce tip < break < root.
taper_bounds_basis: Existing B737 taper study config/optimization/b737800_fleet_taper20_v1.toml bounds reused as exploratory bounds only; legacy protocol not selected.
evidence_policy: Only physical constraints in inner fuel search. Non-DV calibration candidates reviewed separately; EDB and APD landing data cannot tune inputs. No canonical digitized values overwritten.
selection: Lowest raw weighted burned fuel among evaluated feasible candidates; endpoint retained separately

control_search.refinement: bounded scalar refinement around feasible grid minima; report numerical scope
control_search.CL_coupling: Repeat-convergence verification only: TASOPT already refreshes drag inside its CL iteration; max8 passes, fuel relative1e-8/altitude0.01ft.
control_search.CL_schedule: Prescribed CL assigned across clean climb/cruise/descent ipclimb1+1:ipdescentn-1, matching TASOPT altitude-mode broadcasting. Takeoff/landing untouched.

targets.post_design_samples: 3000, 3200, 3400 nmi; straight-segment interpolation of canonical APD corners, not independent digitized points

selection_policy: Corner-first Pareto comparison against O4: do not select candidates that worsen first-corner range or materially move the full-fuel corner; ferry discrepancy is secondary. Retain <=1% compared weights. No V&V residual in inner fuel objective or constraints.
calibration_stage: frozen19DVs sizing; inner fuel scope unchanged
selection_priority: Preserve or improve first maximum-payload corner relative to O4
Keep actual full-fuel corner near APD 2824 nmi and 37446 lb; do not trade it for ferry improvement
Reduce ferry shortfall among corner-preserving candidates
weight_target_reason: MTOW = OEW + 37446 + geometric fuel capacity; all within 1 percent APD weights

candidate_rationale.Q1: Tail Vh1.0 and downwash0.3 combine measured opposing first-corner/ferry sensitivities; nacelle12 and fan efficiency0.905 offset ferry loss. Restore OEW and nominal full-fuel corner payload.
candidate_rationale.Q2: Same as Q1 with tail Vh0.8, testing stronger ferry improvement versus first-corner accuracy.

calibration_assumption_status: Exploratory model assumptions, not measured aircraft properties. Lower-bound downwash and nacelle ratio require explicit interpretation.
